data.name: NeoCarbon
data.description: NeoCarbon GmbH is a Berlin-based DAC startup founded in 2022 by René Haas and Silvain Toromanoff, developing modular solid-sorbent Direct Air Capture reactors that retrofit onto cooling towers and industrial waste-heat sources. The company operates a sorbent chemistry lab, has deployed pilot modules, and was selected in 2025 for German federal BIK funding for its ANEWDACUS hollow-fibre DAC project with permanent storage via concrete carbonation.
